topic: Titan Text: Causal Cellular Automata & Sequential Carry Dynamics

current_hypotheses.statement: Continuous NCA parameterized with orthogonal or skew-symmetric recurrence weights can achieve dissipation-free ballistic transport without discrete STE sign quantization.
CD-DV-NCA implements Bounded DPDA Emulation with effective stack capacity C_stack = min(L, C_c * B) on Dyck-4.
Adaptive step damping factor gamma_t = gamma_0 / (1 + alpha * t) halts loss drift over deep horizons (T >= 64) without degrading bracket accuracy.

confirmed_facts.statement: Recurrent updates are causally required for task execution; zero-tick and state lesions collapse accuracy to 0.0% and loss increases by +3.35 nats (d=15.56).
1D NCA learns instance-specific sequential parity on L=8, tau=8 with G_identity=+18.8% across both slots (Slot 0: 68.8%, Slot 1: 68.8%).
On L=16, tau=16, Slot 0 is solved (71-86%), but interior slots 1 and 2 remain pinned at chance (44-50%) across 1000 epochs, curriculum, coordinate channels, and dense supervision.
Multi-scale coarsening (s=2) yields null result (d=+0.07 vs s=1) on L=16 parity; linear mean pooling annihilates antipodal Z_2 character.
Causal stencil DAG boosts Slot 0 to 85.6%, but interior slots remain at 50% chance; single-slot supervision at Slot 3 yields 56.1% chance, falsifying multi-slot gradient masking.

Causal Recurrence Horizon Campaign (tau=48, N=5 seeds) decisively falsified the settling-latency hypothesis (H1): intact accuracy remained at 46.9%, G_identity=-2.5%, and Linear/MLP probes on Slots 2 and 3 showed 50.8% chance.

Continuous 1D NCA has an empirical correlation length strictly bounded at 4-6 cells: carry information spans 1 chunk (4 cells to Slot 1, 91.4% MLP acc) but collapses to 50.8% chance across 2 chunks (8 cells to Slot 2), invariant to unroll depth tau in [16..48].

Titan NCA with ECR (T=16, Cc=16, causal DAG) achieved 100.0% train accuracy and 76.6% val accuracy on iterated-parity (L=16), outperforming Transformer (55.5%), GRU (55.5%), and baseline NCA without ECR (71.9%).

On iterated-sum-dense (L=16), Titan NCA with ECR (T=16, Cc=16, Causal DAG) lifted validation accuracy from 18.8% (T=8) / 27.3% (T=16 baseline) to 70.3% (Train: 100.0%, Val loss: 0.8027), matching Simple RNN (70.3%) and outperforming Transformer (43.8%) and Untied FF (15.6%).

Persistent input channel (--persistent-input) with ECR on iterated-sum-dense caused static input memorization/overfitting: train loss collapsed to 0.0232 (100% train acc) while validation accuracy dropped to 49.2% (val loss 1.9306) compared to 70.3% without persistent input, proving static input forcing confounds intermediate recurrent accumulation.

Across 3 seeds (42, 100, 2026) on iterated-sum-dense (L=16), Titan NCA with ECR achieved mean Val Acc of 57.8% ± 11.8% (peak 70.3%) with 100% train convergence, outperforming Untied FF (16.7% ± 1.8%) and Transformer (48.4% ± 26.8%), and approaching Simple RNN (62.5% ± 12.2%) and GRU (71.6% ± 7.9%).

Zero-shot OOD length generalization of L=16 trained ECR NCA across 5 seeds: On iterated-parity, accuracy is 66.2% ± 3.1% at L=16, 57.1% ± 4.3% at L=32 (2x OOD), and 51.7% ± 1.6% at L=64. On iterated-sum-dense, accuracy is 53.9% ± 4.5% at L=16, 30.5% ± 3.6% at L=32 (2x OOD, chance 10.0%), and 12.8% ± 2.5% at L=64.

confirmed_facts.statement: On column-arithmetic (L=16), bidirectional ECR with skip stride k=2 lifted Titan NCA validation accuracy from 49.4% (standard NCA baseline, barely above 45.0% dummy baseline) to 58.7% with 100.0% training convergence (loss 0.0219), demonstrating that bidirectional carry channels resolve the reverse carry-ripple bottleneck in multi-digit addition.

Discrete STE carry quantization (ste_sign) mitigates continuous floating-point drift over deep horizons (L=64): on iterated-parity, ste_sign achieves higher in-distribution accuracy at L=16 (58.0% ± 1.4% vs 56.1% ± 2.3% for continuous baseline none) and eliminates sub-random drift at L=64, holding rock-solid stability at 50.5% ± 0.1% where continuous baseline decays to 49.1% ± 2.8% and bistable potential destabilizes to 45.8% ± 7.3%.

On column-arithmetic (L=16), scaling carry capacity to Cc=32, skip stride to k=4, and recurrence horizon to T=24 with bidirectional routing lifts Titan NCA validation accuracy to 60.0% ± 0.3% (peak 60.3%, 100% train convergence), surpassing Simple RNN (58.6%) by +1.4% and closing 71% of the gap between standard NCA (49.4%) and the Transformer ceiling (64.4%), with inter-seed variance collapsing from ±7.6% to ±0.3%.

Extreme OOD (L=128) Causal Reach sweep shows CD-DV-NCA maintains 45.0% (T=16) to 36.7% (T=64) accuracy beating Baseline Causal NCA (39.2% to 31.4%), but unregularized continuous loss explodes monotonically (2.28 -> 16.73) over deep unrolls.

Rate-invariance under transport conjugation benchmark proves spatial roll preserves continuous field norm ||H|| bit-level invariant (delta <= 0.0023 < 0.02) across all 6 conditions (t* in {8, 12, 16}, D in {4, 8}), while channel permutations perturb ||H|| with perturbation decaying from delta=0.35 at t*=8 to delta<=0.05 at t*=16.

Adversarial 4-arm subspace normalization shows Arm B (bounded_h_only) cuts loss by 47% at L=64 (5.13 -> 2.70) and 71% at L=128 (12.45 -> 3.59) while maintaining 30.9% acc, whereas Arm C (full 64 norm) collapses to chance (25.8%), proving discrete carry unattenuation is necessary for pushdown survival while bounding continuous loss drift.

Double-Dissociated Distance-Resolved Non-Local Pushdown Computation Established on Adversarial Balanced-N-Gram Dyck-4: Under uniform bigram balancing and transport gaps G in {0,4,8}, CD-DV-NCA maintains 36.2%-58.3% bracket retrieval (D in {2,4,8}). At local distance d <= 4 cells, continuous channels alone achieve 85-94% accuracy (carry delta +4.1%). At non-local distance d in [6..24] cells, continuous channels collapse to flat chance (24.7%), while discrete carry channels sustain retrieval with causal gains of +14.6% to +25.0% (peaking at 50.0% at d=20). Untied feedforward collapses to 22.4%-25.8% chance across all non-local distances.

unresolved_questions.question: Initial inquiry: Determine whether causal NCA sequential carry failure on L=16 is due to short correlation length of 1D continuous CA, lack of dedicated carry register, or gradient starvation across long chains
Initial inquiry: Implement and evaluate Explicit Carry Register (ECR) decoupling local spatial cell perception from carry propagation to break the 4-cell correlation length limit on L=16

Initial inquiry: Design an infinite-horizon contractive fixed-point mechanism that prevents continuous Lyapunov divergence in H when unrolled to T=64 and beyond, while preserving discrete ballistic pushdown transport of ECR

next_candidate_experiments.name: Adversarial Balanced-N-Gram Dyck-4 Test
next_candidate_experiments.protocol: Sample Dyck-4 sequences under an adversarial filter where all local bigrams are uniform (p=0.25). Measure bracket accuracy for D in [4, 12].

next_candidate_experiments.name: Continuous Unitary vs Discrete STE Sign Comparison
next_candidate_experiments.protocol: Implement skew-symmetric continuous recurrence Delta H = (W - W^T) H and measure correlation length xi and deep bracket accuracy vs discrete STE.

supported_interpretations.statement: Arm B (bounded_h_only) bounds loss growth via a spectral-damping capacity tradeoff rather than an asymptotic fixed point.
supported_interpretations.competing_alternatives: A strictly contractive fixed-point projector with negative real eigenvalues could halt loss growth without expressivity loss.

supported_interpretations.statement: Continuous state H acts as local syntactic carrier wave and clock trigger, while discrete C_c acts as non-local LIFO payload.
supported_interpretations.competing_alternatives: Nonlinear dense layers entangle H and C_c during early ticks (t* <= 8), coupling pushdown dynamics.

known_confounds.confound: Shallow Bracket Density: 50% of brackets in standard Dyck-4 have nesting depth D <= 2, allowing local n-grams to reach ~40% accuracy.
known_confounds.mitigation_or_weakness: Evaluate performance strictly on depth-stratified subsets D in [4, 16] and adversarial balanced n-grams.

known_confounds.confound: Unconstrained Continuous Drift: Models trained at fixed unroll T=20 develop Lyapunov drift at T >= 32.
known_confounds.mitigation_or_weakness: Apply subspace normalization (Arm B bounded_h_only) or step damping to bound continuous field norms.

known_confounds.confound: Static Input Memorization: Persistent input channels cause input memorization and drop validation accuracy from 70.3% to 49.2%.
known_confounds.mitigation_or_weakness: Do not provide persistent input channels during intermediate recurrent accumulation.
